Page.title: Capabilities
Page.description: Explore Ajared Research Inc's capabilities: applied AI research, AI product development, enterprise agents, and data strategy for modern organizations.

Capability.title: Product Development & Management
Capability.subtitle: From idea to a product your customers use
Capability.Description: Get a working product in front of customers without hiring a product team first. We find out what your users actually need, then design, build and ship it with you, and keep improving it after launch.

Does.Do: Know what customers will pay for before you spend money building it.
Turn a rough idea into a clear, scoped product you can explain to your team and investors.
Ship something people understand the first time they use it, tested with real users before any code is written.
Always know what to build next and why, without a full-time product hire.
A production-ready product, not a demo that breaks the first time real customers use it.

Capability.title: Enterprise AI Agents
Capability.subtitle: Hours back for your team every week
Capability.Description: Take repetitive work off your team's plate. Agents handle documents, data entry and routine decisions across the tools you already use, and a person steps in only where judgment matters.

Does.Do: Routine tasks handled for you, with your team approving only the calls that need a human.
Ask your company’s documents and data a question and get an answer you can trust, with sources.
Fewer copy-paste jobs between systems, and fewer mistakes from doing them by hand.

Capability.title: Data and AI Strategy
Capability.subtitle: Know where AI pays off before you spend
Capability.Description: Know exactly where AI will pay off in your business before you spend on it. We look at your data and your operations, then give you a plan your team can act on, not a slide deck that sits in a drawer.

Does.Do: AI answers your team can rely on, grounded in your own data instead of guesswork.
See where your customers, outlets and opportunities are, and decide where to grow next.
Get recommended when customers ask ChatGPT and other AI assistants about what you do.
Make confident AI decisions as a founder or leader without having to become a technologist.
